title: Waboda language - Wikipedia
text: Waboda is a Papuan language of southern Papua New Guinea. In Kiwai Rural LLG, it is spoken in Dameratamu, Gesoa, Kabaturi (8.236886°S 143.574376°E), Maduduo, Meipani, Sagero (8.232149°S 143.536743°E), Tirere (8.233195°S 143.644705°E), and Wapi (8.444552°S 143.538194°E) villages. [2][3]

title: Trans–New Guinea languages - Wikipedia
text: Trans–New Guinea (TNG) is an extensive family of Papuan languages spoken on the island of New Guinea and neighboring islands, a region corresponding to the country Papua New Guinea as well as parts of Indonesia.
